lessons.title: Discriminative vs Generative AI
lessons.description: Understand how generative models synthesize novel samples by modeling data distributions, comparing VAEs, GANs, and Diffusion.

lessons.title: Large Language Models & Pretraining
lessons.description: Explore causal autoregressive language modeling, predicting next tokens, compute scaling laws, and transformer decoders.

lessons.title: Alignment & Fine-Tuning (RLHF & LoRA)
lessons.description: Transform raw base models into helpful assistants via Instruction Tuning, RLHF, DPO, and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA).

lessons.title: Prompt Engineering & RAG Systems
lessons.description: Master zero-shot, few-shot, and Chain-of-Thought prompting, and integrate vector databases for Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
